newsitem.title: USA: Barney's picks Dickson to recapitalise company.
newsitem.headline: Barney's picks Dickson to recapitalise company.

text.p: Barney's Inc and the Official Committee of Unsecured Creditors said they reached a preliminary agreement allowing Dickson Concepts to recapitalise the bankrupt retailer.

The agreement, announced late on Sunday, came just before an August 4 extended deadline. Under the agreement, Dickson will pay Barney's $205 million in cash and a $42 million note that will be funded by certain Asian royalty payments, according to Barney's.
In return, Dickson will get a 51.0 percent stake of the reorganised company, with Barney's getting about a 49.0 percent stake, Barney's added.
Barney's said the court has given it, the creditors' committee and Dickson until August 15 to finalise a definitive agreement.
Barney's filed for Chapter 11 in January 1996.
A Barney's spokesperson was not immediately available to comment further.
